description_en: If you use an Active Directory (AD) directory to connect to your enterprise AD, call this operation to retrieve user information from your enterprise AD
description_zh: 如果您使用AD目录来对接企业自有AD，调用该接口可以获取企业AD中的用户信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd list-directory-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --filter alice --directory-id cn-hangzhou+dir-jedbpr4sl9l370000 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --max-results 10 --ou-path example.com/Domain_Controllers --assigned-info 1 --sort-type asc --include-assigned-user true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDirectoryUsers

parameters.help_en: The region ID. To get a list of regions that WUYING Workspace supports, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The string for a fuzzy search. The operation returns all results that contain this string
parameters.help_zh: 模糊查询字符串。包含该字符串的结果都将被匹配出来
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The token used to start the next query. If this value is empty, no more results are available
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

- Maximum value: 100.

- Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

- 最大值：100。    
- 默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The path of the organizational unit (OU) in the AD domain. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311259.html to obtain the OU path
parameters.help_zh: 指定用户所属的AD域组织单元（OU）。可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311259.html接口获取
parameters.name: ou_path

parameters.help_en: > This parameter is not publicly available. You can only set this parameter to `1` or leave it empty
parameters.help_zh: > 该字段未开放使用。只能传入`1`或者不传入任何值
parameters.name: assigned_info

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only users who are assigned cloud desktops
parameters.help_zh: 是否只返回分配云电脑的用户
parameters.name: include_assigned_user
